name: cc-mods
description: Session cockpit: tmux state, policy, auth radar, PR band, flow/graph/side/outputs panes

browser.title: Browser for links
browser.description: Where links this session opens go: inherit (tmux @browser / tmux-chrome default), tweb (TWeb, Electron), tweb-chrome (TWeb on your Chrome), chrome (this window's Chrome tab group). /browser changes it for the session.

browserEmbed.title: Draw TWeb pages in the cockpit
browserEmbed.description: Off (default): pages open in a TWeb pane right of this session, and the Web tab (6) shows that pane's tabs and controls (back, reload, float, focus, close). On: with browser set to tweb or tweb-chrome, pages are drawn inside the Web tab itself.

browserFrameRate.title: Web tab frame rate
browserFrameRate.description: Most frames a second the Web tab draws while the page moves; it drops to 4 at rest.

cockpitOnStart.title: Open the cockpit at start
cockpitOnStart.description: Every interactive session opens the cockpit on its own, docked to the right of a fullscreen transcript (above the prompt otherwise), without taking the keyboard. /cockpit closes it for the session.

browserEngineRules.title: Web tab engine by URL
browserEngineRules.description: Pages whose URL matches open on that engine in the Web tab: pattern=engine, comma separated (claude.ai=chrome, *.okta.com=chrome, github.com/acme=webkit). A host matches its subdomains, * any run of characters; first match wins. The Settings tab's list, once edited, replaces this.
